title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Fubuki Azuma's Arc 1
content: The 9th Squad of the Anti-Demon Corps.
It was a special unit composed solely of the Azuma clan.
The head of the Azuma family, Toka Azuma, had long guided the Anti-Demon Corps as its Supreme Commander.
In the past, there had been an incident—numerous Shuki appeared in Shiba Park, Minato Ward, Tokyo, through a Kunado from Mato.
Fortunately, it was nighttime and there were few people around, but it was still a situation that could lead to a disaster.
Toka Azuma was in charge of their extermination.
As soon as she arrived at the scene, she leaped in front of the Shuki.
"Hey, demons, over here♪"
Saying this, Toka formed a seal with her fingers.
"I'm glad I was nearby. I can eliminate you before any damage occurs."
Upon spotting Toka, the Shuki lunged at her with terrifying agility.
"East's Star Frost."
Toka Azuma's ability, East's Star Frost, allows her to absorb the life force of others.
The targets from which she can drain life force include animals, plants, and even Shuki.
With that life force, she can rejuvenate herself and heal wounds, and furthermore...
"Golden Bow and Arrow!"
She could release the accumulated life force and turn it into an attack.
Hundreds of golden arrows, created from the life force, appeared in the air.
Toka had stored a sufficient amount of life force in her body in preparation for emergencies.
"Go!"
The golden arrows rained down on the Shuki like a torrential downpour.
With the speed of these arrows, the Shuki had no chance to evade.
"Ha ha! Even though I came all the way to this world, I picked the wrong opponent!"
Toka's loud laughter mixed with the screams of the Shuki, turning Shiba Park into chaos.
With the merciless bombardment of arrows, the monstrous beings were quickly obliterated.
"Maybe I went a bit overboard."
After the onslaught, damage was evident in various places around Shiba Park.
"It's hard to hold back in this world."
These damages were not caused by the Shuki, but by Toka's attacks.
Well, as long as there were no casualties, I suppose that's good!
The historic sites seem to be safe.
If necessary, we can just say it was the Shuki's doing.
The name Toka Azuma comes from a flower that wards off demons.
Her personality and thinking were as bold as her name suggested.
"Now that I've used my power, I'm hungry. I think I'll buy some taiyaki on the way home."
In this manner, Toka Azuma had long ruled as the Supreme Commander and head of the Azuma family.
She had elevated the already prestigious status of the Azuma family to an even greater height.
Eventually, the position of Supreme Commander of the Anti-Demon Corps would be passed on to Ren Yamashiro.
And a change of heart came to Toka Azuma as well.
"What? Riu is stepping down from the position of commander?"
Her comrade and confidant, the 1st Squad Commander, Riu Meika, was resigning.
"That's right. Well, I’ve been in this position for quite a long time."
Riu Meika was of an age that was considered quite old for the young members of the Anti-Demon Corps.
"You could still easily fight, Riu."
"I can fight. But I have to hand things over to the younger generation; it wouldn't be healthy otherwise."
"Has a young person emerged who can make you decide that? Is it that girl I've heard you talk about sometimes?"
"That's right. Konomi Tatara. I'm entrusting the 1st Squad to her."
"Konomi just became a high school student, didn't she?"
"Yeah. She's a fresh high school girl."
"At that young age, she must be inferior compared to other commanders."
"Ah, but if we start training her now, she could aim for the position of Supreme Commander in a few years."
"Really? Does she have that much potential?"
"If I support her as the vice commander, she can manage being a commander while still being a high school girl."
"Ha ha! You're serious, Riu. You really work hard."
"Unlike Toka Azuma."
"That's good for you, Riu. You can do things freely."
"Toka Azuma has power, so she can do things freely."
After stepping down from the position of Supreme Commander, Toka Azuma had entrusted the leadership of the 9th Squad to her daughter, Fubuki Azuma.
And she herself was enjoying her activities as a member of the 9th Squad.
While the Supreme Commander takes care of various tasks, once she was no longer in that position, the mundane tasks suddenly became bothersome.
"I'm envious that you met such a promising young person."
"What are you talking about? Toka Azuma has an excellent daughter, Fubuki."
"She is excellent, but I think she still lacks a bit to inherit the Azuma name."
No, no, you're underestimating Fubuki too much.
Because of your personality, she listens to you well.
You just think her obedience is lacking.
"Hmm."
"Fubuki Azuma is a wonderful talent. The child of a lion is a lion."
Riu said nothing more to Toka Azuma.
Toka Azuma's daughter, Fubuki Azuma, was a girl of few words.
But the boldness she harbored within had often shown itself since childhood.
While walking along the banks of the Tamagawa River with her mother, a runaway ferocious dog came charging towards them.
She could have responded instantly using her ability, but Toka Azuma deliberately chose not to.
She was curious about how her own blood would react in such an emergency.
(I'll observe until the last moment.)
Then, her daughter, who was still in elementary school and had yet to even eat a peach, stepped forward to protect her mother.
"Mother, take a step back towards the river."
Fubuki had somehow removed her jacket and was wrapping it around her arm.
"If it comes, I'll take it down."
The pressure emanating from Fubuki caused the ferocious dog to hesitate and eventually calm down.
"Ha ha! Good courage, Fubuki. You were planning to push it down to the riverbed if it attacked, weren't you?"
"It was fortunate we encountered it by the riverside; there was a clear path to victory."
Fubuki was already over 165 centimeters tall for an elementary school student.
She had been rigorously trained in martial arts, exuding the aura of a strong person.
The charm radiating from her entire body was sometimes so striking that she could be mistaken for a college student.
Her academic performance was also impeccable.
The blood of this lineage flows strongly in Fubuki.
I'm so pleased.
Now, let's see what kind of dangerous ability will manifest from the peach of Mato.
I'm excited.
What Fubuki manifested was a retractable spear.
When Toka Azuma learned of this ability, she felt a bit disappointed.
She had hoped that the Azuma would control time, at least.
That was something realized by her granddaughter, Yachiho, which led Toka to dote on Yachiho.
Toka thought Fubuki's ability was too plain for an Azuma.
However, as Fubuki began to defeat Shuki, that evaluation changed.
With each enemy Fubuki defeated using her spear, its attack power increased, and the length of the spear extended.
The spear, which grew stronger without limit, eventually reached a point where it could no longer gain strength from defeating ordinary Shuki.
"The spear that pierces the sun" was no longer just a name.
When Riu pointed this out, Toka Azuma reflected on Fubuki's past and realized that Fubuki had shown sufficient qualities to be the head of the Azuma family.
As her daughter, Fubuki was expected to be loyal to her, but Fubuki was so obedient that it felt lacking.
That seemed to be the reason Toka Azuma had viewed Fubuki as somewhat inferior.
"I see, perhaps it's time for me to consider it as well."
Having witnessed the generational change in her friends up close, Toka Azuma began to think about passing on the headship.
Thus, the ceremony to select the next head of the Azuma family, "The Evening Banquet of the East," was held.
The winner of "The Evening Banquet of the East" was the favored Fubuki, and Toka Azuma passed the headship to her.
Toka realized through the ceremony that she had underestimated Fubuki.
With Fubuki at the helm, the Azuma would continue to be strong; Toka was convinced of this.
She was also pleased that Himari Azuma, whom she had thought was a long shot, had shown considerable potential.
She felt that she could entrust the Azuma to the next generation.
Thus began a new era of the Azuma family under Fubuki's leadership.
In the 7th Squad of the Anti-Demon Corps, Himari Azuma was consulting with Kyouka Uzen, the squad leader.
"A concentrated training camp at the Azuma household?"
Yes.
I discovered the potential of a copying ability during the Evening Banquet.
If I can use Toka Azuma's ability to some extent, the 7th Squad will have healing capabilities.
"That would be significant."
Of course, like with other abilities, I can't use it at all right now, but I'll gather more information from Toka Azuma.
Himari had been able to master Saki's weaponization ability from the 5th Squad.
However, she had been unable to master Kaiko's healing ability, no matter how much she listened to her.
"So, you're going to train rigorously at home?"
"Yes, they are a clan with proven skills."
Himari said this, but she no longer hated the Azuma family as much as she once did.
"Alright, I give you permission. Do your best."
Kyouka said this and gave Himari a light pat on the back.
"That means I'll be absent from the 7th Squad for about three days. I won't need any meals or anything."
Himari informed Yuki, the caretaker, about her outing.
"Can I go with you?"
"Huh? It's fine without you this time."
"You'll be training, right? I want to get stronger too. Plus, I need to use my time off as a caretaker."
"You plan to use your time off for training? That spirit is good, but you should really take a proper rest."
Fubuki's massages make my fatigue disappear.
Besides, I think it's a good time to push my body a little.
I need to prepare for the battle against the Eight Thunder Gods.
"You say that. Alright, if you insist, I won't stop you. But you might get turned down."
"If that happens, I'll just give up quietly."
Thus, a message from Himari arrived on Fubuki Azuma's device.
"Oh, accepted."
With a prompt reply, Himari and Yuki adjusted their schedules and headed to the Azuma household.
In Denenchofu, Tokyo, just a minute's walk from the Tamagawa Kunado that connects to the 9th Squad dormitory.
The large house there was the Azuma family home.
"It's unfair, isn't it? The Azuma family has their home and workplace just a minute apart."
Due to the exceptional location, the 9th Squad often rested at home rather than in the dormitory.
"Then, are you going to transfer to the 9th Squad, Himari?"
Yuki nudged Himari with his elbow, and she returned the gesture.
"Just kidding. I'll be working with the commander forever."
The commander she referred to was Kyouka Uzen.
"Aren't you aiming for the commander's position?"
"If the commander becomes the Supreme Commander, I might become the commander from the vice commander position."
Just then, Yachiho Azuma, Himari's sister, approached Yuki and Himari.
"Hey, hey, Himari. Hey, hey, hey."
"Are you a seal or something?"
You've become quite cheeky, little sister.
I heard you're training at the Azuma household.
I've come to train there as well.
Aren't you happy?
Your big sister is here with you.
"Well, I appreciate the effort... thanks, big sister."
You managed to say thank you, good job, Himari.
Now, I'll guide you through everything; your sister is great after all.
With that, Yachiho turned her gaze to Yuki.
"I know you, Yuki Wakura."
At that moment, the trademark glasses of Maika Azuma appeared as she came out from inside the house.
"We've been waiting for you. Homare will also adjust her schedule to participate in the training."
"Ugh."
"If Homare gets involved again, just hit her. I'll back you up."
Homare Azuma was Himari's sister, but not her biological sister.
In the direct line of the Azuma family, names with three kanji characters are given, like Toka Azuma, Fubuki Azuma, and Himari Azuma.
Homare was adopted into the main family from a branch of the Azuma family, recognized for her abilities.
"Seems like it's going to be lively after all."
"It doesn't have to be lively, you know."
Upon entering the Azuma household, Yuki was led to the guest room.
It seemed that there were several such Japanese-style rooms in the spacious Azuma residence.
"Why are the futons already laid out?"
At that moment, Fubuki Azuma appeared alone.
"Welcome! Now, lie down over there. I'm glad I prepared the futons in advance."
"Y-yes?"
I could tell just by looking at your body.
You're accumulating fatigue.
I'll give you a massage from the Azuma family.
"Thank you, then let's get started."
Yuki was only staying for two days using his vacation, so time was limited.
He couldn't afford to waste time feeling shy.
"Is this position okay for lying down?"
"Start face down. That's right, just trust me."
Yuki began to receive Fubuki's meticulous massage.
As she worked to ease his slight tension, Fubuki kneaded his body with her palms.
Her fingers firmly stimulated delicate areas like the groin.
Yuki's body reacted with a jolt to her delicate movements.
"Ticklish? Just bear with it a little."
"Y-yes, I'm fine."
"Good boy."
As she gently patted his head, Yuki's heart calmed astonishingly.
Eventually, as they became more closely entwined, a sweet fragrance wafted from Fubuki's body.
Yuki couldn't help but swallow hard.
Then, when he turned onto his back, Fubuki straddled him.
Overwhelmed by the sensation on his body, Yuki continued to receive her treatment while being gazed at by her loving eyes.
The massage remained skillful, and soon the fatigue lingering in Yuki's body began to dissipate.
"Thank you, I feel so light."
"Everyone is gathered in the training area. Let me guide you."
"Yes, I'll participate in the training."
Yuki eagerly headed towards the Azuma family's training area.
(Just how large is this Azuma household? Are they using some ability to expand it?)
To Yuki's eyes, the house seemed to stretch endlessly.
The figure of Fubuki walking ahead was incredibly graceful.
While Kyouka's back was full of life force, and just watching her strong stride energized him, Fubuki captivated him in terms of allure.
Eventually, they arrived at the training area within the house.
(This training area alone is about the size of a school martial arts dojo.)
It was a place akin to a dojo, spacious enough for training.
Himari was already dressed in training clothes.
"There's a changing room in this room."
Led by Fubuki, Yuki was taken to the adjacent room.
"This size should fit well. Change into this for training."
"Y-yes, but Fubuki, I can change by myself."
Yuki was surprised when Fubuki almost started to undress him.
"I just wanted to take care of a boy."
(Oh right, Fubuki said something like that during the first commander meeting I participated in.)
"W-well, I might be too big to be called a boy anymore, but go ahead."
"You're so kind. Good boy."
Fubuki happily began to help Yuki.
"Are you also off today, Fubuki?"
"It's just a break time."
"Thank you for spending your precious time with me."
With Fubuki's help, Yuki finished changing.
When he returned to the dojo, Himari was moving her body while talking to Yuki.
"Just in time, we're about to have a spar with some visitors."
"S-spar?"
The Azuma household often welcomed guests from various backgrounds.
Today alone, practitioners of capoeira, combat sambo, and jeet kune do were present.
They had been invited as part of the Azuma household's combat training.
"Even with a change of leadership, this tradition continues."
"The Azuma must remain strong; the philosophy has been passed down. Now, do your best in training."
Fubuki returned to her duties in the 9th Squad.
"So, who will fight first?"
"I will. Himari and Yuki Wakura."
"Homare. You're here."
"I'm getting stronger and stronger. The revenge from the banquet is coming soon, Himari."
"Bring it on."
"Perfect timing, you should watch. Watch my performance. Right, Yuki Wakura?"
As Homare moved closer to Yuki, Himari quickly stepped in between them.
"Your guard is tight, huh? Well, that's fine."
Homare faced off against a combat sambo practitioner.
"Is the opponent a user of the peach ability?"
"That's right, a physical enhancement type. In a one-on-one, they can defeat even Shuki. The rules are anything goes."
"Oh, this is serious."
Depending on the situation, we might train in the alternate space we used during the banquet.
We can go all out there.
"Wouldn't it be better to always train in the alternate space? The building might get destroyed."
"We need to prepare for combat in the real world as well."
"Right, I don't have much experience in real-world combat, so this might be just the right training."
Homare began her fight with the combat sambo practitioner.
Her ability was "Flowing Clouds and Water."
With pre-planned actions constructed in her mind, her body executed them.
During this, her physical strength was significantly enhanced.
By inputting commands in small increments in her mind, Homare was pushing her opponent back.
"Oh, this is an intense fight, what incredible power."
"The Azuma has healers, so we can train without holding back."
"The foundation for training is well established."
"Training is tough for us, though. We've been doing this since childhood."
Homare was momentarily stopped by her opponent's trained reflexes and was almost caught in a joint lock, but she managed to escape with a bite.
Then, Homare roughly pinned her opponent down.
"Haah, haah, did you see that? I won easily."
"Good job."
"O-oh. You're acknowledging me, Yuki Wakura."
"That was quite a brute force win. But a win is a win."
"Alright, next, capoeira!"
Homare eagerly jumped into the next fight.
"They're fighting fiercely. I need to stretch thoroughly. Help me out."
"You're observing everyone's movements closely, Himari."
Well, yeah.
Even if it's Homare, I can praise her where it's due.
I think respect is necessary to master a copied ability.
"You're impressive. Give me a little respect too."
Yuki was mostly surrounded by older members in the Anti-Demon Corps.
While there were younger members like Rei and Shushu, Himari, who was treated as a peer, was a rare presence with whom he could speak casually.
"Just help me with the stretching properly."
"Hey, make sure to watch my fight, okay? Move!"
Himari's distraction allowed a capoeira kick to land squarely on Homare.
